name: XITS Math (font, in SwiftMath)
note: SwiftMath 1.7.3 ships xits-math.otf in mathFonts.bundle, copied into the app as a resource. The copyright is the font's own name-table notice; the licence is the STIX Font License, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (mathFonts.bundle/OFL.txt). SwiftMath's collector-walked mathFonts.bundle/LICENSE is MathChat's MIT notice for the plists, not the fonts.
